name: Neural Deformable Voxel Grid (NDVG)
definition: A fast deformable radiance field method for dynamic scene view synthesis that integrates voxel-grid optimization with a deformable radiance field. It replaces heavy MLP computations with fast voxel-grid feature interpolation to enable space-time view synthesis for dynamic scenes captured by a monocular camera.
summary: Neural Deformable Voxel Grid is a fast dynamic scene view synthesis method that replaces heavy MLP computations with voxel-grid feature interpolation to enable efficient space-time rendering.
